messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: cont-batch streaming path (us-west-2) p99 latency > 4s, error spikes on streaming responses. Paging oncall: @Alicia. Trigger: alerting.rule=contbatch_stream_p99_threshold
Alicia: on it. Affected customers? any customer-facing timeouts or retries? :eyes:
Samir: we have multiple customer reports (CS ticket #7732) - streaming stalls where client sees no tokens for ~3-6s then a burst. Logs show 'scheduler: holding batch for seqlen bucket mismatch' and many `enqueue_delay` ~900-1500ms. request ids: r-3f4a, r-5b2c.
Priya: could be mixed-seqlen amplification. What's p95/p99 right now? Grafana link: https://grafana.internal/d/contbatch/streaming-latency (paste for reference)
Samir: quick numbers from short window: p50 ~90ms, p95 ~820ms, p99 ~4200ms, streaming stalls correlate with high mix of short+long sequences. error rate (streaming timeouts) up ~0.8% -> baseline 0.05%.
Alicia: customer impact: CS says 2 mid-market customers saw degraded UX (chat stalls) and 1 timed out and retried (retry led to duplicate tokens). Flagging as P1 for potential SLA impact.
Priya: first mitigation options: 1) enable preemptive-shedding on cont-batch scheduler for streaming path (drops long-waiting items into fallback stream), 2) temporarily cap max batch size for streaming route, 3) route streaming requests from affected customers to dedicated small-variant model (lower mem, shorter latency). Which is fastest?
Jordan: quickest is flip preemptive-shed flag. Command (ops-admin):
```
# enable preemptive shedding for streaming route in us-west-2
curl -X POST "https://ops-admin.internal/api/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" -d '{"flag":"contbatch.preempt_shed.streaming.us-west-2","value":true}'
```
Alicia: do that and also reduce max_batch in scheduler to 32 for streaming route to avoid huge packing delays. Jordan, can you run both?
Jordan: applying now. patch/id: patch-3748. Running flag flip...
ops-bot: ACTION: flag contbatch.preempt_shed.streaming.us-west-2 = true by Jordan at 3748205402
Jordan: also applied scheduler override: `max_batch_streaming=32` in runtime config and restarted routing-worker in us-west-2 (graceful restart).
Samir: tail checks: within 60s p99 dropped to ~1100ms, p95 ~420ms. still above normal but much better. streaming stalls rate down by ~70%.
Alicia: good. notify CS and affected customers that we're mitigating and investigating root cause. Priya can you gather sample traces? Need KV cache hits, seq len distribution, and queue wait histogram for affected hosts.
Priya: collecting traces now. early look: big spike in seq-len variance (many 16-token prompts mixed with 1024-token completions). KV cache churn high for long-seqlen sessions causing eviction thrash. also seeing scheduler preference to wait for larger batches when mixed traffic present.
Charles: long-term fixes proposal: - per-seqlen batching lanes (small/medium/large) so we don't pack incompatible seq lengths, - adaptive batch caps based on observed seqlen variance, - make preemptive-shed auto-enable when queue wait > X ms for streaming route, - tune KV cache from pure LRU -> size-aware LRFU to reduce thrash.
Alicia: agree. Create RFC and a short runbook for oncall: when mixing traffic detect, enable preemptive-shed + cap batch size + if still bad, route heavy customers to dedicated variant. Also add an alert for seq-len-variance > threshold.
Jordan: opening incident playbook ticket: https://issues.internal/IR-5843 (links notes + actions). Assigning to eng-runtime for fix: Priya, Charles.
Priya: I'll instrument a per-route histogram of seq length and add a dashboard panel. Also will capture per-batch composition logs for next 24h for analysis.
Samir: CS update: told customers we're mitigating; one customer still seeing occasional bursts but overall UX restored. They're asking for RCA ETA.
Alicia: target: initial RCA + postmortem in 48h. For now leave preemptive-shed on and max_batch_streaming=32. Jordan, add a TTL to the flag change (auto-revert after 24h unless cleared).
Jordan: done. added TTL=24h on the flag. ops-bot: NOTE: flag auto-revert scheduled at 3748291310 unless updated.
ops-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation applied, customer impact reduced, monitoring for recurrence.
Charles: postmortem action items (short): 1) implement per-seqlen lanes (owner: eng-runtime), 2) KV cache policy experiment (owner: eng-ml), 3) scheduler fairness param sweep and safe defaults (owner: eng-platform), 4) oncall runbook update (owner: oncall-docs).
Alicia: thanks team. handing off to next oncall (Samir) at end of shift. Samir you own the follow-ups and the RCA coordination with CS. Please update IR-5843.
Samir: ack. I'll pull traces and draft RCA. Will loop in CS and schedule 1:1 with affected customers if needed.
Alicia: closing live mitigation thread, keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
